answer: Admission auction blocks bulk forgery: each epoch the network auctions 50 slots, and a beacon posts the clearing price first. A bidder stakes a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, locked for 20 epochs; only top bidders enter. Forging 100 identities means winning 100 slots, costing 100 prices plus 100 locked bonds, more than those copies could earn. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards, while an idle relic account loses its slot.
